findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so automatic annual rotation of key material is disabled (the default is false, and the code comment confirms this is intentional). Key material therefore never rotates, extending the period during which a compromised or weakened key remains valid for data that includes audit/log content.
